### POST /crm/segments

Security: `[{"bearerAuth": []}]`.

Parameters:
```json
[
  {
    "$ref": "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
  }
]
```

Request body:
```json
{
  "required": true,
  "content": {
    "application/json": {
      "schema": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CreateSegmentRequest"
      },
      "examples": {
        "static": {
          "summary": "Manually maintained list",
          "value": {
            "name": "Manual VIP List",
            "segment_type": "STATIC",
            "scope": {
              "type": "BUSINESS"
            },
            "description": "Manually maintained VIP relationship group"
          }
        },
        "dynamic": {
          "summary": "Repeat customers over the last 30 days",
          "value": {
            "name": "Active Repeat Customers",
            "segment_type": "DYNAMIC",
            "scope": {
              "type": "BUSINESS"
            },
            "rule": {
              "schema_version": 1,
              "root": {
                "op": "AND",
                "children": [
                  {
                    "field": "commercial.completed_order_count",
                    "operator": "GTE",
                    "value": 5
                  },
                  {
                    "field": "commercial.last_completed_order_at",
                    "operator": "WITHIN_LAST",
                    "value": {
                      "amount": 30,
                      "unit": "DAY"
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "op": "OR",
                    "children": [
                      {
                        "field": "relationship.capability_type",
                        "operator": "IN",
                        "value": [
                          "RESTAURANT",
                          "FAST_FOOD",
                          "CLOUD_KITCHEN",
                          "PASTRY_BAKERY"
                        ]
                      },
                      {
                        "field": "crm.tags",
                        "operator": "HAS_TAG",
                        "value": {
                          "tag_id": "crmtag_vip"
                        }
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Responses:
```json
{
  "201": {
    "$ref": "#/components/responses/SegmentResponse"
  },
  "403": {
    "$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
  },
  "409": {
    "$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"
  },
  "422": {
    "$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationFailed"
  },
  "503": {
    "$ref": "#/components/responses/Unavailable"
  }
}
```

### POST /crm/segments/preview

Security: `[{"bearerAuth": []}]`.

Parameters:
```json
[
  {
    "$ref": "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
  }
]
```

Request body:
```json
{
  "required": true,
  "content": {
    "application/json": {
      "schema": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/PreviewRequest"
      },
      "examples": {
        "branchHighValue": {
          "summary": "High-value customers at one branch",
          "value": {
            "scope": {
              "type": "BRANCH",
              "branch_ref": "brn_lekki"
            },
            "rule": {
              "schema_version": 1,
              "root": {
                "op": "AND",
                "children": [
                  {
                    "field": "commercial.net_spend_minor",
                    "operator": "GTE",
                    "value": {
                      "currency": "NGN",
                      "minor": 10000000
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "field": "relationship.capability_type",
                    "operator": "IN",
                    "value": [
                      "RESTAURANT",
                      "PASTRY_BAKERY"
                    ]
                  }
                ]
              }
            },
            "sample_limit": 25
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
